artworks.title: Idomeneus
artworks.description: Riva's Cretan king — the spearman of eighty ships who came home from Troy to find Meda dead and Leucus on his throne.

artworks.title: The Wrath of Achilles
artworks.description: Tiepolo's camp scene — Idomeneus among the captains Agamemnon summoned, before the Returns poisoned the wives at home.
